site.sitedescription: Two Frog Lake is a small single basin unstratified freshwater lake. It is located in the Seymour-Belize Inlet Complex, situated in the central coastal mainland of British Columbia. Surrounding vegetation: The vegetation in this region is dominated by Tsuga heterophylla and Tsuga plicata.
